svg.title: dots.tts NFE comparison: RTX 3090 and RTX 4090 x-vector
svg.desc: Matched full-sweep comparison of latency, real-time factor, and output duration by NFE.
svg.text: dots.tts full NFE sweep: RTX 3090 vs RTX 4090 x-vector
54 matched prompts • 9 NFE settings • one measured generation per prompt/NFE • 486 results per run
Median latency by NFE is 27% to 35% lower in the x-vector 4090 run.
Median RTF changes -11% to -6%; median WAV length changes -2.72 to -2.00 seconds.
Hardware and conditioning changed together. This compares the two full systems, not the x-vector effect alone.
Wall-clock time per generated WAV across the prompt set.
RTF = latency / WAV duration. Values below 1 are faster than playback.
Generated clip length across prompts. Duration alone does not verify spoken content.
Colors: blue = original run, orange = x-vector run. Dots = prompts. Whiskers = IQR. Warmups excluded.
